scope: cross-browser engineering screen; both run upstream Playwright, no Flashwright backend or same-browser speed claim
primaryMetric: Complete watchdog elapsed includes source materialization, server, original runner suite, validation and observed cleanup. Browser installation/build excluded equally.
advancementRule: Advance only if WebKit reduces complete-owner elapsed >=20% in at least three of four application/worker cells in both opposite-order blocks, all gates pass. Report 2x majority separately. Otherwise stop this stock WebKit performance route; not a universal browser conclusion.

webkit.distribution: Ubuntu24.04 x64 WPE fallback on Arch host
webkit.launcher: Private wrapper preserves WPE environment and adds locally extracted Ubuntu ABI libraries to LD_LIBRARY_PATH. No browser patches or host package changes.
webkit.initialLaunchFailure: Official wrapper replaced the supplied LD_LIBRARY_PATH; original unsupervised launch exited 127. Retained separately from corrected supervised functional and timing runs.

inputs.bindingScope: Full runtime/dependency manifests bracket timing; earlier functional runs have per-run harness/source hashes and browser version handshakes, not complete pre-launch runtime manifests.

limitations: Browser engine differs; not Chromium conformance.
Ubuntu24 WebKit WPE distribution on Arch host with local official Ubuntu ABI dependencies.
Browser command path is upstream Playwright in both arms.
Sampled process/resource data does not prove exhaustive custody.
Two small applications are not the final representative matrix; no backend service workload.
No Flashwright-versus-Playwright comparison on WebKit was performed.
Sampled memory is diagnostic only; no complete tree CPU/memory admission.
Availability and startup omissions for declarative feature contracts are a separate experiment.
Acquisition archive has no independently checked published checksum; retained actual runtime file hashes identify these runs.
decision: Do not build a Flashwright WebKit backend for performance on this evidence. Preserve the functional feasibility result and all slower observations. This rejects this stock-browser route for these workloads, not all WebKit configurations or future native changes.
sanitization: Normalized workspace/home path keys in source/runtime manifest; raw evidence hashes still identify private original files. No measurements or statuses changed.
